title: Radial Kernel Attention for Long-Range Modeling in Polymer Machine Learning Force Fields
abstract: arXiv:2610.41675v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Radial Kernel Attention (RKA) for long-range modeling in polymer machine learning force fields. Local neighbor graphs constrain communication across polymer chains and their surrounding environments, while explicit all-pair attention incurs quadratic cost. RKA maps atomic distances from the cluster centroid to learned radial features and combines their overlap with content-dependent queries and keys. Factorized aggregation and readout enable global feature exchange at linear cost in atom count for fixed feature dimensions. We insert the invariant scalar update between EquiformerV3 local blocks and obtain conservative forces by differentiating the total energy, including its radial coordinate dependence. We evaluate energy and force prediction for finite polymer-derived clusters in OPoly26. translated_title: 聚合物机器学习力场中长程建模的径向核注意力
translated_abstract: 我们提出了径向核注意力（Radial Kernel Attention, RKA），用于聚合物机器学习力场中的长程建模。局部邻居图限制了聚合物链及其周围环境之间的信息传递，而显式的全对注意力机制则会带来二次方的计算代价。RKA 将原子到团簇质心的距离映射为可学习的径向特征，并将其重叠与依赖于内容的查询和键相结合。通过因子化的聚合与读出操作，在固定特征维度的情况下，全局特征交换的计算代价随原子数量呈线性增长。我们将这一不变标量更新插入到 EquiformerV3 的局部块之间，并通过微分总能量（包括其对径向坐标的依赖性）来获得保守力。我们在 OPoly26 数据集上评估了有限聚合物衍生团簇的能量和力预测。我们的模型在官方训练集上训练了 12 个周期，训练完成后直接在完整的官方验证集上进行评估（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出径向核注意力（RKA），以线性的计算代价实现聚合物机器学习力场中的长程相互作用建模，并通过微分总能量获得保守力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Radial Kernel Attention (RKA), enabling long-range modeling in polymer machine learning force fields at linear computational cost, with conservative forces obtained by differentiating the total energy.
